issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber() is specified (UML and text) to return an int (the number of remaining orders), but the solution implements it as `public void calculateRemainingOrderNumber()` and prints "Order number: ..." lines instead of returning a value. Students following the spec will implement/expect an int-returning method, while the provided solution API differs.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and expected API) to `public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber()` and return the remaining queue length (e.g., `return orders.length;`). If printing is intended, move printing to a separate method (e.g., `printRemainingOrderNumbers()`) so this method matches the specified signature/behavior.

issues.description: The exercise requires adding getters for private fields (implying read-only access), but Stock exposes a public mutator `setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[])` that is not specified in the UML. This extra public API can undermine the intended encapsulation by allowing replacing the entire stock array directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove `setStockIngredients(...)` (or reduce its visibility, e.g., package-private) to keep Stock consistent with the UML, or explicitly add this setter to the UML/spec as an allowed helper (clearly marked as testing/debug-only).
